See also: ObjectsHelp
You see a great spirit potion.
It weighs 3.10 oz.
This potion can only be consumed by paladins and monks of level 80 or higher.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 250 and 350 Hit Points, and between 125 and 185 Mana Points, around 300 health and 150 mana on average.
See also: Money Spent per Mana Point and Capacity Taken per Mana Point

History

  • Monks gained the ability to consume these potions with the release of the Monk Vocation Update on April 08, 2025.
  • The price was further increased from 228 gp to 254 gp with the Summer 2024 Update on Jul 01, 2024.
  • The price was increased from 190gp to 228 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 100x Great Spirit Potions went from 15 Tibia Coins to 18 Tibia Coins.
    • 250x Great Spirit Potions went from 34 Tibia Coins to 41 Tibia Coins.
